R1: The preserved run-1 config passes current structural and stateful loading (66 Git references, 1 external input, 0 exhibits). No raw child/session log, invoking script, or argv exists, so the historical swallowed exception and timing remain explicitly indeterminate; no root cause was invented. Production-stage ordering is now typed in the shared Recorder seam.
R2: Split `loadRecorderConfigStructure` from `validateRecorderConfigState`; production now completes structural declaration/path/identity/conflict validation before filesystem/Git/stateful work. Added a production-bin regression proving an indexed invalid kind beats a nonexistent repository and returns typed location `["declarations","gitReferences",0,"kind"]` without spawn.
R3: Added stable `internal-error`, typed `recorder.location`, and bounded allow-listed `recorder.diagnostic` (`stage` + error-class category). Unknown exceptions no longer become `invalid-config`; no raw message, stack, config, argv, environment, or offending value is exposed. Existing scanner still scans the complete failure JSON. README documents typed consumption rather than prose parsing.
R4: Changes are solely in shared `runRecorder`; no role branch, retry, recurrence, routing, or issue #13 behavior was added. Existing exact child exit/signal, post-child Recorder-failure, one-spawn, and `not-spawned` tests pass.
R5: Preserved admission, scanning, cleanup, manifest/Receipt, and atomic promotion paths. Evidence: focused Recorder suite 70/70; full suite 350/350; `npm run typecheck`; `npm run build:recorder`; `npm pack --dry-run`; preserved-config validation; `git diff --check`; same-pattern search found no remaining unknown-to-`invalid-config` final catch. Generated `dist/recorder/*` artifacts committed by convention. Forward commit: `1db6c4c3e3c6e48032df31075e9d75a5e7b87845`.
